classes.name: FramebufferD3D
classes.description: A class representing a Direct3D framebuffer implementation, providing methods for framebuffer operations such as clearing, reading pixels, blitting, and state synchronization.

classes.name: ClearParameters
classes.description: A struct holding parameters for clearing framebuffer contents, including color, depth, stencil, and scissor settings.

methods.description: Clears the framebuffer with specified mask.

methods.name: clearBufferiv
methods.description: Clears a color buffer with signed integer values.
